gloss: number of long objects; number of runs (trains, buses)

definitions.explanation: The count or quantity of objects counted with the counter {本|ほん}, such as bottles, pens, trees, or legs.

definitions.gloss: number of runs, frequency of service
definitions.explanation: The number of train runs, bus services, or similar scheduled departures. Commonly used when discussing transportation frequency.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本数|ほんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えた→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: I counted the number of pens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本数|ほんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed the number of film rolls to use in the movie shoot.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本数|ほんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This train line has few runs.
The number of bus services increases during the morning rush.

examples.japanese: ⟦{終電|しゅうでん}→終電：05296_shuuden⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本数|ほんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}らされて→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧になった。
examples.english: The number of late-night train services was reduced, making things inconvenient.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of the counter {本|ほん} (for long, thin objects) and ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). Sense 2 (transportation frequency) is extremely common in daily life — {本数|ほんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (few trains/buses running) is a frequent complaint about rural or late-night services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本数|ほんすう}: number of train runs
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本数|ほんすう}: number of bus services
- {本数|ほんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: few runs/services
- {本数|ほんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the number of services
